real_sample_qualification.note: The 2026-08-17 confirmation was recorded for the prior parameters and cue-id rendering (window/output bounds max_kv_size 8192 / max_tokens 4096, cue ids rendered as the full {part_id}:{track_id}:{ordinal}). For this v3 revision the context window was raised to 32768 and the output budget to 16384 so the whole run-1 transcript fits a single whole-transcript call (the broken overlapping technical-block windowing was removed), and the cue ids shown in the prompt were switched to a token-efficient Part-local form (P{index}:{position}) that is remapped back to the full canonical cue ids before adjudication. Those changes alter the prompt the model sees, so the prior real-sample confirmation no longer applies: real-sample semantic-quality re-confirmation by the maintainer on real zh+en material is pending. Recorded observation carried forward from Phase 11 ticket 15: the model groups a single-topic clip into one segment; multi-segment behaviour is not yet exercised and remains to be tuned against human reference.

notes: Model-specific text-semantics decoding calibration profile (ADR 0056) for the Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-8bit engine executed through the Model runtime subprocess (ADR 0055) with mlx-lm. model_identity binds the exact pinned model asset SHA-256, the mlx-lm backend and version, the 8-bit precision, the apple-m1 device class, and the text-analysis rules fingerprint; any bound-identity change invalidates the profile. prompt_template_version binds the versioned prompt template the profile was calibrated for, so a prompt revision invalidates the profile. This profile was recalibrated for prompt-template v2 (Phase 11 ticket 15), which renders each cue's verbatim recognized text and the exact output envelope into the prompt; the ticket-10 v1 prompt carried only cue identities and produced no segmentable content. decoding fixes the deterministic sampling controls: temperature 0.0 is decoded as greedy argmax and seed makes the (already deterministic) run reproducible, max_tokens bounds the generation length, and max_kv_size bounds the KV cache. This v3 revision raises the context window to 32768 and the output budget to 16384: Qwen3-4B natively supports a 262144-token context, so the whole run-1 transcript now fits a single whole-transcript call and the previous overlapping technical-block windowing (which made segments un-tileable and forced the conservative fallback) has been removed; a pre-flight token-budget gate rejects a prompt that would not fit before any model is loaded. The cue ids shown in the prompt were switched to a token-efficient Part-local form (P{index}:{position}) that the engine remaps back to the full canonical {part_id}:{track_id}:{ordinal} identities before adjudication, so the 64-hex source id is no longer repeated on every cue line. qualification_scope is 'pending_reconfirmation': the maintainer's earlier confirmation was recorded for the previous window/output bounds and the full cue-id rendering, so it no longer applies to this revision; real-sample semantic-quality re-confirmation by the maintainer is pending. Model-proposed boundaries and content are always validated against the revalidated cue evidence by the unchanged Text-model output projection and adjudication, so this profile never makes unproven model output authoritative.
